# K0 — always-loaded surface (CLAUDE.md + decision register), product inputs, root build assets

@@ output/template/CLAUDE.md ;; Always loaded (project memory); imports docs/architecture/decision-register.md.
@scope always (planning-time, all work)
1 NN ;; Banner (kind, scope, owner, loading metadata).
3 NN ;; Heading.

C x.precedence-layers EX - MUST ;; CLAUDE.md and the decision register govern every task; path-scoped standards govern the files they cover; workflows own procedures; knowledge skills supply technique and never override a standard. ;; repo/meta (instruction precedence) ;; none ;; Instruction-layer precedence is not an oracle policy.
C x.product-inputs-no-override EX GOV-001,GOV-008 MUST_NOT ;; SPECIFICATION.md, CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, feature specifications and task prompts are product inputs: they may request a decision change but never silently override CLAUDE.md, the decision register or a standard. ;; = ;; none ;; Product-input vs engineering-policy precedence not stated in the oracle.
C x.vocab-default-report EX - MUST ;; Vocabulary: a must/must-not violation is a defect; a deviation from a 'default' needs a concrete reason and must be reported; prefer/avoid are guidance; 'requires approval' marks a Reserved decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Reporting obligation for default deviations is not in the oracle.
C gov001.spec-authoritative OL GOV-001 MUST ;; A non-empty SPECIFICATION.md is authoritative for project-specific functional requirements and observable behaviour; the empty template file is intentional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov003.no-invent OL GOV-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not silently weaken, contradict or materially extend approved behaviour; do not invent user-visible rules, limits, defaults, restrictions or workflows the product sources do not define. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov004.propose-ask OL GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; If an omitted detail must be decided and materially affects observable behaviour, propose the smallest reasonable option and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.routine-delegated OL GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Routine internal implementation choices that do not change observable behaviour are Delegated. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.string-semantics OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Observable string semantics (case sensitivity, collation, culture/ordinal comparison, normalization, trimming, uniqueness, lookup) are product behaviour; when undefined do not choose silently and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov008.custom-settings OL GOV-008 MUST ;; CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md owns approved tunable product limits and defaults; SPECIFICATION.md owns behavioural intent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; The two product sources must not contradict; on conflict stop and ask which source must be corrected. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.no-invent-tunable OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not silently invent a material tunable value: propose it with its reason, get approval, record it in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.sync-workflow OL GOV-021 MUST ;; After recording an approved tunable value synchronize it (workflow custom-settings). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.exclusions OL GOV-011 MUST_NOT ;; CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md must not contain secrets, environment-specific connection details, package versions, HTTP status codes, ports, migration identifiers or incidental implementation constants. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.simplicity OL GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Default to the simplest maintainable solution with proportional architectural complexity and no speculative abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-speculative OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce frameworks, libraries, infrastructure or architectural patterns without a concrete current need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep changes focused on the requested scope and preserve existing behaviour unless the task or approved specification requires a change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.challenge OL GOV-018 MUST ;; When a request raises a material concern (duplication, poor cohesion, trigger/loading problems, context cost, conflict with an accepted decision, unnecessary complexity) name the concern and propose an alternative first; never silently rewrite or ignore the requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decided OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decided choices (decision register, approved product sources, established project structure) are followed and not reopened without approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.approved-tech OL DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Use an approved technology instead of silently selecting an alternative. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.delegated OL GOV-017,GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Delegated choices (local, reversible, no material boundary/dependency/convention/contract/behaviour change) are decided without asking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.reserved OL GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved choices require explicit approval unless the approved specification or established project structure already requires them; the list is a minimum. ;; = ;; Already required by the approved specification or project structure. ;;
C arc020.reserved-decision-change OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing an accepted project/architecture decision or replacing an approved baseline technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-styles OL ARC-020,ARC-004,ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; New architectural styles/patterns are Reserved: Rich Domain Model or DDD tactical patterns, CQRS, mediators (MediatR, Kommand), Vertical Slice Architecture, event sourcing, microservices. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-new-project OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A new production project, layer or assembly is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-refgraph EX ARC-020,ARC-001 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A change to the project reference graph is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Not gated by ARC-020.
C arc020.reserved-persistence OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Persistence boundaries or persistence technology, including multiple DbContexts, are Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-infra OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; New messaging, background-processing or distributed-cache infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-infra-extra EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; New search, external storage or external identity infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Beyond ARC-020's list.
C x.reserved-major-lib EX DEP-001,GOV-013 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A new major library or framework is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; The oracle requires a concrete need, not approval.
C arc020.reserved-result OL ARC-020,API-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A project-wide Result model is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-convention EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Any project-wide convention or abstraction other code must follow is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Generalizes ARC-020's project-wide Result example.
C arc020.reserved-auth OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Authentication or authorization architecture is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking-reserved OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A breaking public API change is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-versioning EX API-013,DEP-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting API versioning is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; API-013 requires a concrete need, not approval.
C gov004.reserved-product OL GOV-004,GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Product behaviour or tunable values the product sources do not define are Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.unclear-test OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Unclear case: any 'yes' to the five questions (dependency/framework/infrastructure, project/layer/reference boundary, convention, observable behaviour or public contract, expensive to reverse) makes it Reserved. ;; = ;; Unclear cases. ;;
C gov017.decision-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; For a Reserved decision raise a Decision Request (Context, Options, Recommendation, Blocked, Proceeding with) and wait. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.instruction-as-approval EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; An explicit user instruction counts as approval; every accepted decision must be recorded (workflow architecture-decision). ;; = ;; none ;; Recording obligation added to GOV-017.
C gov017.headless OL GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; In autonomous/headless runs take only a policy-compliant non-Reserved path, never make a Reserved decision silently, and list unresolved Decision Requests in the final report. ;; autonomous or headless runs ;; none ;;
C gov015.git-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, force-push, delete branches or run any other repository-changing Git operation unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov016.parallel OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Parallel implementation work uses separate branches or worktrees; unrelated changes stay out of the current branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.route-dev-workflow OL WF-001 MUST ;; Planning or implementing a new application, feature, bug fix, refactor or other non-trivial change runs development-workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.route-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Before declaring any implementation work complete run verify. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.template-maint-user-only EX - MUST ;; Changes to the instruction system go through /template-maintenance, which the user runs (never model-invoked); the model asks the user to run it. ;; repo/meta (instruction-system change) ;; none ;; Instruction-system maintenance gate not in the oracle.

C gov021.cs-run-workflow OL GOV-021,GOV-008 MUST ;; Changes to CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md run the custom-settings workflow; file rules are in CLAUDE.md § Product sources. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/SPECIFICATION.md ;; Product input; empty in the template (no non-blank lines).

@@ output/template/Directory.Build.props ;; Root build asset.

C dep023.shared-only OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Only genuinely shared settings in Directory.Build.props; project-specific settings stay in their own project files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.tfm OL DEP-008 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; Shared target framework net10.0. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.build-settings EX DEP-023,RUN-009 ENFORCED_DEFAULT ;; Shared build settings Nullable enable, ImplicitUsings enable and AnalysisLevel latest. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete compiler/analyzer settings not in the oracle.

@@ output/template/Directory.Packages.props ;; Root CPM asset.

C dep006.cpm-enabled OL DEP-006 ENFORCED ;; ManagePackageVersionsCentrally is enabled. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep006.cpm-comment OL DEP-006,DEP-003 MUST ;; PackageVersion entries are added by add-dependency with the latest stable compatible version verified at install time. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc020.dr-change-reserved OL ARC-020,GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Every register entry is Decided; changing an entry is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.dr-update-affects EX GOV-007 MUST ;; architecture-decision updates the register entry and every artifact listed in Affects; policy detail stays with the 'Details in' owner. ;; = ;; Register changes. ;; Decision-propagation mechanism not in the oracle.
C arc001.d01-clean-arch OL ARC-001,ARC-003,ARC-006,ARC-010,ARC-013,ARC-016 DECIDED ;; Clean Architecture with Domain, Application, Infrastructure and Api production projects and inward dependencies; Controllers as HTTP entry point; Application Services orchestrate; specific repositories with IUnitOfWork as commit boundary; simple Domain entities. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.d02-no-mediator OL ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; CQRS handlers, MediatR, Kommand, Vertical Slice Architecture or similar mediator-based organization are not adopted; introducing them requires explicit approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.d03-platform OL DEP-008 DECIDED ;; .NET 10 LTS on its latest stable servicing release, C# 14, ASP.NET Core and Controllers; preview/RC .NET or C# requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep009.d04-persistence OL DEP-009 DECIDED ;; EF Core with Microsoft SQL Server (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer); provider-specific concerns stay out of Application and Domain. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.d05-validation OL DEP-010,API-010 DECIDED ;; FluentValidation (FluentValidation, FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions) for explicit request and use-case validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.d06-logging OL DEP-010,RUN-013 DECIDED ;; ILogger<T> in application code with Serilog as provider (Serilog.AspNetCore; sinks only as required). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep012.d07-swagger OL DEP-012,API-017 DECIDED ;; Swashbuckle Swagger UI at /swagger is the Development documentation and manual-testing surface; outside Development only when requirements justify it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.d08-tests OL DEP-013,TST-001,TST-006 DECIDED ;; NUnit; backend test projects under backend/ beside production projects; WebApplicationFactory<Program> for integration tests; Testcontainers conditional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep014.d09-frontend OL DEP-014,DEP-007 DECIDED ;; Current stable Angular via Angular CLI (CLI-selected TypeScript/RxJS), standalone APIs, strict mode, routing, zoneless when supported, SCSS, Angular Material/CDK, Vitest; npm workspace. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep015.d10-not-default OL DEP-015 MUST_NOT ;; NgRx, Axios, Lodash, Bootstrap, Tailwind or additional form/component/state libraries are not added by default; built-in Angular first; extras need a concrete requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.d11-mapping OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Manual mapping for simple cases; Mapster (Mapster, Mapster.DependencyInjection) approved when mapping volume warrants it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep020.d12-resilience OL DEP-020,DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience for HttpClient and Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience for other pipelines, approved only when a real integration needs resilience. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep016.d13-playwright OL DEP-016 DEFAULT ;; Playwright is the approved default when E2E coverage is required; not part of the minimal scaffold. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.d14-docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Docker is optional; add container artifacts only when the project or its deployment actually needs them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api013.d15-versioning OL API-013,DEP-017 DEFAULT ;; API versioning not adopted until a published-compatibility need exists; when adopted use Asp.Versioning with its Controller integration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep022.d16-slnx OL DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; .slnx solution format; legacy .sln only when an external tool or requirement needs it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.d17-build-config OL DEP-023,DEP-006 DEFAULT ;; Repository-level Directory.Build.props for genuinely shared build settings and Directory.Packages.props for CPM; project-specific settings stay in their projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.d18-layout OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; backend/<Name>.<Layer>/ for production and backend test projects, frontend/<Name>.Web/ for the Angular workspace, docs/ for documentation; no top-level tests/ directory. ;; = ;; none ;;
